newsitem.title: USA: Tampa sees 2 Fla. power units back Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Tampa sees 2 Fla. power units back Saturday.

text.p: Tampa Electric Co said Friday two units at its coal-fired Gannon generating facility would resume operation Saturday after tripping off line earlier this week to repair boiler tube leaks.
Gannon's unit 4 is rated at 200 megawatts (MW) and unit 5 245 MW.
Moreover, the 445 MW unit 2 at the coal-fired Big Bend power complex was planned to return to service Monday following its scheduled maintenance outage, a Tampa Electric spokesman said.
The Gannon and Big Bend stations are in Tampa, Fla.
Tampa Electric is a subsidiary of TECO Energy Inc.
